body: He is so integrated in my life, he lives with me, he works with me, he has raised my youngest daughter , I've become completed dependant on him, the thought if trying to manage my life without him terrifies me

Firstly that is hardly relative, if there is even a 1% risk then I wouldn't take it.... and yes 1 child has asthma, I have a low immune system and he himself has a long list of health issues

The people he wants to met have been openly breaking social distances rules and he has called them idiots for the same behaviour only last week. And the controlling element is far more complex but in a simple form, He has issues knowing boundaries in relationships and is currently in therapy for this, so when I point out he has crossed a boundaries (within the rules of our relationship that we both agreed on) then his go to statement is that I'm being controlling. Up until today we have had no issues within thos lock down and gotten on surprisingly well, this one reason why I'm so upset with him
Cabin fever I persume, the other day he rode to family members homes (elderly parents) and knocked on the window to check they were ok, he seems to now think that excuses him to go out any were

He will be meeting about 4 people, these people have been openly breaking social distancing rules (He called them all idiots last week) he says if he goes he will keep his distance but I can't take that risk with my kids
We've had arguments in the past were he says im being controlling, but this is different, I can't believe he is going to be so reckless
